captures.label: healthy
captures.seen: Two healthy striped zebras; tall but continuous legs with distinct hoof ends, no detached/crossed strips. Close crops heads but legs visible; whole species silhouettes wide. Personally inspected all eight original-size panels in paired-zoom sheet. Courier face, green launcher and pale/red boots remain readable against dark grass. Wide views establish silhouette/readability, not fine wound pixels.
